items.title: Immunoblot analysis as a helpful adjunct to determine the time of a CMV infection in pregnancy
items.summary: CONCLUSION: Immunoblot band patterns are systematically associated with CLIA IgG avidity and may serve as a helpful adjunct in determining the timing of a CMV infection in pregnancy.
